mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate over the past month signals an active monetary easing cycle, which reduces the discount rate applied to future equity cash flows and drives positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20-day returns in less than 55% of instances when FEDFUNDS declines, or the Rank IC over any 2-year rolling window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A rise in the unemployment rate above 7.0% over the past month signals weakening labor market conditions, which increases the likelihood of central bank rate cuts and triggers a flight to equity risk assets, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20-day returns in more than 60% of triggered instances, or the average forward return in triggered periods is not significantly positive (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in both residential construction starts and consumer spending (RSAFS) signals a broad-based weakening in private demand, which increases the probability of monetary policy accommodation and leads to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX fails to produce positive 60-day returns in more than 60% of interaction-triggered instances, or the joint signal has a Rank IC below 0.02 over any 3-year window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in industrial production below 99.5 over the past month signals a contraction in real economic output, which increases the likelihood of central bank intervention and drives positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20-day returns in more than 60% of triggered instances, or the average forward return is not significantly positive (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sharp decline in real personal consumption expenditures (RSAFS) combined with a drop in housing starts (HOUST) signals a collapse in private demand, which triggers a policy response and leads to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX fails to generate positive 60-day returns in more than 60% of interaction-triggered cases, or the joint signal has a Rank IC below 0.02 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A rise in the CPI inflation rate above 2.5% over the past two months signals persistent inflationary pressure, which increases the probability of delayed rate cuts or further tightening, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20-day returns in more than 60% of triggered instances, or the average forward return is not significantly negative (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in payroll employment and a rise in the unemployment rate signals a labor market slowdown, which increases the likelihood of central bank intervention and drives positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX fails to produce positive 20-day returns in more than 60% of interaction-triggered instances, or the joint signal has a Rank IC below 0.02 over any 3-year window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained contraction in real GDP growth (GDPC1) over the past four quarters signals a deepening economic slowdown, which increases the probability of aggressive fiscal or monetary stimulus and leads to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 60-day returns in more than 60% of instances when GDPC1 is negative, or the Rank IC over any 3-year rolling window is below 0.03.
